newsitem.title: UK: European cotton sees good late summer demand.
newsitem.headline: European cotton sees good late summer demand.

text.p: West European traders reported a sustained demand for cotton to meet shipment requirements during the late summer and early autumn.
Some fresh business has been concluded in Central Asian styles but one of the noteworthy market features in France has been the purchase of West African.
traders said this growth has been prefered both on price and quality considerations.
Little reference has been made to the conclusion of fresh transactions in Northern Hemisphere new crop descriptions.
